content.short: Nosana is a pioneering decentralized AI compute network on Solana connecting developers with idle GPU capacity and NOS.
content.description: Nosana is a pioneering Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) built on Solana, designed to create a scalable and cost-effective marketplace for AI compute power. By connecting AI developers who require high-performance GPU resources with individuals and data centers that have idle capacity, Nosana significantly lowers the barrier to entry for AI inference and model training. This decentralized approach provides a robust alternative to centralized cloud providers, offering up to 90% cost savings for complex computational workloads. Leveraging Solana's high speed and low latency, Nosana ensures transparent and efficient settlement for compute jobs using the NOS utility token.
